about.heading: System Identity
about.intro: Frontend developer with experience building workflow automation tools, production-grade applications, and scalable user interfaces using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies.
paragraphs: I specialize in building systems that think in flows. My experience includes developing interactive workflow diagrams using React Flow, building production-grade Next.js applications, and creating reusable component libraries.

At Hridayam Soft Solutions, I worked on the Collection System production project, integrating RESTful APIs with Laravel backend and building responsive interfaces using Next.js and Ant Design. I developed custom NPM packages and collaborated with backend teams on code reviews and version control using Git/GitHub.

Previously, I worked as a freelance Frontend Developer at Gnapika, building e-commerce platforms and integrating APIs with Flask and FastAPI backends. I also completed an internship at RCube Consulting, where I developed interactive diagrams using React Flow for business process visualization.
I hold a Master of Computer Applications degree from Chandigarh University (CGPA: 7.48/10) and a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology from Mumbai University.
